knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r Import libraries, echo = FALSE}

##### LIBRARIES #####

library(plyr) # round by 0.5
library(lubridate) # dates 
library(ggplot2)# graphs 
library(lmtest)# dwtest
library (DHARMa)# test autocorrelation
library (FSA)# Dunn's test
```

```{r setup the data}

# setting working directory #change with the path were the data are 
setwd("C:/Users/LENOVO/Desktop/stage mahidol/stat/project/monitor_FID")

# charging dataset #change with the path were the data are 
data_monitor_rain <- read.csv("C:/Users/LENOVO/Desktop/stage mahidol/stat/project/monitor_FID/DATA/pro/fid_monitor_rainyss_process.csv", header= T, sep = ";")
#View(data_monitor_rain)

###### EXCLUDE OBS OTHER THAN V_SALVA ######
data_monitor_rain = data_monitor_rain[(data_monitor_rain$sp=="V_salva" ) ,]
#View(data_monitor_rain)

###### EXCLUDE OBS WITHOUT FID  ###### 
data_monitor_rain = data_monitor_rain[!is.na(data_monitor_rain$FIDi),]
#View(data_monitor_rain)

###### EXCLUDE OBS WITHOUT SIZE  ###### 
data_monitor_rain = data_monitor_rain[!is.na(data_monitor_rain$size),]
#View(data_monitor_rain)

###### EXCLUDE OBS WITHOUT DISTANCE TO SHELTER  ###### 
data_monitor_rain = data_monitor_rain[!is.na(data_monitor_rain$d_fr_refug),]
#View(data_monitor_rain)


##### STANDARDIZE THE DATES ##### 

dates = data_monitor_rain$date

# lubridate automatically detects format
standardized_dates = parse_date_time(dates, orders = "dmy")

# Convert to date class 
standardized_dates = as.Date(standardized_dates)

standardized_dates

data_monitor_rain$date = standardized_dates

# Create datasets for the sites separately 

data_rain_salaya =  data_monitor_rain[(data_monitor_rain$site=="salaya" ) ,]
data_rain_phuttha =  data_monitor_rain[(data_monitor_rain$site=="phutthamonthon" ) ,]


```

```{r FID vs SITE}



##### mean and median FID for salaya and phutthamonthon ##### 
summary(data_monitor_rain[(data_monitor_rain$site== "salaya" ) ,]$FIDi) #mean FID 2.625  15/04
sd(data_monitor_rain[(data_monitor_rain$site== "salaya" ) ,]$FIDi)

summary(data_monitor_rain[(data_monitor_rain$site== "phutthamonthon" ) ,]$FIDi) #mean FID 3.375 15/04
sd(data_monitor_rain[(data_monitor_rain$site== "phutthamonthon" ) ,]$FIDi) 


#### n° of obs per site #######

table(data_monitor_rain$site) # almost balanced 

ggplot(data_monitor_rain, aes(x=site)) + 
  geom_bar()

###### preliminary kruskal test and plot######
kruskal.test(data_monitor_rain$FIDi~as.factor(data_monitor_rain$site), data=data_monitor_rain)


p = ggplot(data = data_monitor_rain)+
    geom_boxplot(mapping = aes(x = site, y = FIDi, color = site))+
    scale_color_brewer(palette="Dark2")+
    theme(legend.position="none")
p = p + labs(x = "Site", 
    y = "FID (m)",
    title ="Rainy season",
    phutthamonthon = "Phutthamonthon") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels=c("phutthamonthon" = "Phutthamonthon", 
                              "salaya" = "Salaya"))
p

```

```{r FID vs SIZE : SALAYA }

##### mean FID for salaya ##### 
summary(data_rain_salaya[(data_rain_salaya$size== "S" ) ,]) #mean FID 3.533
sd(data_rain_salaya[(data_rain_salaya$size== "S" ) ,]$FID) # sd = 1.9
summary(data_rain_salaya[(data_rain_salaya$size== "M" ) ,]) #mean FID 2.478
sd(data_rain_salaya[(data_rain_salaya$size== "M" ) ,]$FID) # sd = 2.2
summary(data_rain_salaya[(data_rain_salaya$size== "L" ) ,]) #mean FID 1.60
sd(data_rain_salaya[(data_rain_salaya$size== "L" ) ,]$FID) # sd = 1.2

#### n° of obs per size #######

table(data_rain_salaya$size) # not balanced 

ggplot(data_rain_salaya, aes(x=size)) + 
  geom_bar()

###### preliminary kruskal test and plot######
kruskal.test(data_rain_salaya$FIDi~as.factor(data_rain_salaya$size), data=data_rain_salaya) # yup

dunnTest(FIDi ~ size,
         data=data_rain_salaya,
         method="bonferroni")

p = ggplot(data = data_rain_salaya)+
    geom_boxplot(mapping = aes(x = size, y = FIDi), color = "#d95f02")
p = p + labs(x = "Size (L = Large, M = Medium, S = Small)", 
    y = "FID (m)",
    title ="Rainy season: Salaya")
    
p 
```

```{r Closest VS chosen shelter}
# remove observations without closest or chosen shelter
data_shelter_rain = data_monitor_rain[(data_monitor_rain$closest_ref_type!="" ) ,]
#View(data_shelter_dry)

data_shelter_rain = data_shelter_rain[(data_shelter_rain$gone_ref_type!="" ) ,]
#View(data_shelter_dry)

table = table(data_shelter_rain$closest_ref_type, data_shelter_rain$gone_ref_type)
addmargins(table)

```

```{r ln() transformation}

# we ln() transform to account for skewed data
ln_monitor_rain = data_monitor_rain
ln_monitor_rain$FIDi =  log1p(ln_monitor_rain$FIDi) # transforms with natural logarithm after adding 1 to every measure to keep absence as 0. 
ln_monitor_rain$d_fr_refug =  log1p(ln_monitor_rain$d_fr_refug)
View(ln_monitor_rain)

# we recreate de salaya and phutthamonthon datasets
ln_rain_salaya =  ln_monitor_rain[(ln_monitor_rain$site=="salaya" ) ,]
ln_rain_phuttha =  ln_monitor_rain[(ln_monitor_rain$site=="phutthamonthon" ) ,]
```

```{r ln() linear model Salaya}


####a) Model ####

model_dfs_ln_s <- lm(FIDi ~ d_fr_refug , data=ln_rain_salaya)


####b) Conditions of validity ###### 
model_dfs_ln_s.res <- residuals(model_dfs_ln_s)

# independance of residuals 
dwtest(model_dfs_ln_s) # OK 

par(mfrow = c(2, 2), oma = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
plot(model_dfs_ln_s) # rather ok 

# normality of the residuals 
p = ggplot()
p = p+ylab ("Frequency")
p = p + xlab ("Pearson residuals")
p = p + theme (panel.background = element_blank())
p = p + theme (panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 1))
p = p + theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill="white", color ="white", linewidth = 1))
p = p + theme(text = element_text(size = 15))
p = p+ geom_histogram(colour = "black", fill = "white", data = ln_rain_salaya, aes(model_dfs_ln_s.res), bins = 12)
p # rather OK

shapiro.test(model_dfs_ln_s.res) # OK 

# homoskedasticity
bptest(model_dfs_ln_s) #OK 

# DHARMA test for autocorrelation  

# SPATIAL AUTOCORRELATION TEST ON THE RESIDUALS 

res_dharmareg_inter = simulateResiduals(model_dfs_ln_s)

testSpatialAutocorrelation(res_dharmareg_inter, x =  ln_rain_salaya$long, y = ln_rain_salaya$lat) # okay 

# TEMPORAL AUTOCORRELATION TEST ON THE RESIDUALS

### on the scale of field days ###

# recalculate residuals to account for repetitive dates (aggregate by time)

res_grouped_reg_day <- recalculateResiduals(res_dharmareg_inter, group = ln_rain_salaya$date)

# Test temporal autocorrelation 

testTemporalAutocorrelation(res_grouped_reg_day, time = unique(ln_rain_salaya$date)) # okay

### on an hour scale ###

# CHECK IF THE FORMAT PARAMETER IS THE SAME AS IN THE COLUMNS  

ln_rain_salaya$hour <- as.POSIXct(paste(ln_rain_salaya$date, ln_rain_salaya$time), format="%Y-%m-%d %H") #if doesn't work try ln_rain_salaya$hour <- as.POSIXct(paste(ln_rain_salaya$date, ln_rain_salaya$time), format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") and then remove the minutes and the seconds 


# recalculate residuals to account for repetitive dates (aggregate by time)

res_grouped_reg_hour <- recalculateResiduals(res_dharmareg_inter, group = ln_rain_salaya$hour)

# Test temporal autocorrelation 

testTemporalAutocorrelation(res_grouped_reg_hour, time = unique(ln_rain_salaya$hour)) # okay 

#### c) Results ####
summary(model_dfs_ln_s) # seems quite okay I just don't know how to graph that. 

#Plot the data and correlation slope 
p = ggplot(data = ln_rain_salaya)+
    geom_point(mapping = aes(x = d_fr_refug, y = FIDi), color = "#d95f02" )
p = p + 
        xlab("ln(Distance from closest shelter) (m)") +
        ylab("ln(FID) (m)") +
        ggtitle("Rainy season: Salaya") 
p
```


```{r ln() linear model Phuttha}

####a) Model ####

model_dfs_ln_p <- lm(FIDi ~ d_fr_refug , data=ln_rain_phuttha)


####b) Conditions of validity ###### 
model_dfs_ln_p.res <- residuals(model_dfs_ln_p)

# independance of residuals 
dwtest(model_dfs_ln_p) # OK 

par(mfrow = c(2, 2), oma = c(0, 0, 2, 0))
plot(model_dfs_ln_p) # funellish to the right in the first graph + weird Q-Q plot

# normality of the residuals 
p = ggplot()
p = p+ylab ("Frequency")
p = p + xlab ("Pearson residuals")
p = p + theme (panel.background = element_blank())
p = p + theme (panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 1))
p = p + theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill="white", color ="white", linewidth = 1))
p = p + theme(text = element_text(size = 15))
p = p+ geom_histogram(colour = "black", fill = "white", data = ln_rain_phuttha, aes(model_dfs_ln_p.res), bins = 12)
p # not OK 

shapiro.test(model_dfs_ln_p.res) # not OK 

# homoskedasticity
bptest(model_dfs_ln_p) #OK 

# DHARMA test for autocorrelation  

# SPATIAL AUTOCORRELATION TEST ON THE RESIDUALS 

res_dharmareg_inter = simulateResiduals(model_dfs_ln_p)

testSpatialAutocorrelation(res_dharmareg_inter, x =  ln_rain_phuttha$long, y = ln_rain_phuttha$lat) # okay 

# TEMPORAL AUTOCORRELATION TEST ON THE RESIDUALS

### on the scale of field days ###

# recalculate residuals to account for repetitive dates (aggregate by time)

res_grouped_reg_day <- recalculateResiduals(res_dharmareg_inter, group = ln_rain_phuttha$date)

# Test temporal autocorrelation 

testTemporalAutocorrelation(res_grouped_reg_day, time = unique(ln_rain_phuttha$date)) # okay

### on an hour scale ###

# CHECK IF THE FORMAT PARAMETER IS THE SAME AS IN THE COLUMNS  

ln_rain_phuttha$hour <- as.POSIXct(paste(ln_rain_phuttha$date, ln_rain_phuttha$time), format="%Y-%m-%d %H") #if doesn't work try ln_rain_phuttha$hour <- as.POSIXct(paste(ln_rain_phuttha$date, ln_rain_phuttha$time), format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") and then remove the minutes and the seconds 


# recalculate residuals to account for repetitive dates (aggregate by time)

res_grouped_reg_hour <- recalculateResiduals(res_dharmareg_inter, group = ln_rain_phuttha$hour)

# Test temporal autocorrelation 

testTemporalAutocorrelation(res_grouped_reg_hour, time = unique(ln_rain_phuttha$hour)) # okay 

#### c) Results ####
summary(model_dfs_ln_p) # seems quite okay I just don't know how to graph that. 

#Plot the data and correlation slope 
p = ggplot(data = ln_rain_phuttha)+
    geom_point(mapping = aes(x = d_fr_refug, y = FIDi), color = "#1b9e77")
p = p + 
        xlab("ln(Distance from closest shelter) (m)") +
        ylab("ln(FID) (m)") +
        ggtitle("Rainy season: Phutthamonthon") 
p
```
